Included is a 1080p .wmv from DMM/R18 with the DRM losslessly removed or a remux from the Blu-ray Disc of the four Hitomi movies that have been released on Blu-ray. Info from Wikipedia  
Hitomi Tanaka, also known as simply Hitomi, born July 18, 1986, is a Japanese AV idol and gravure idol noteworthy for her naturally large breasts, Japanese size 97J\[2\] (about 42H in a US bra size).  
  
She debuted as a clothed model in 2007 and appeared in her debut "gravure" (non-nude) video, Hitomi Tanaka Bakunyuu J no Shogeki, in November 2007. As a gravure idol, she was compared to an earlier "big-bust" gravure model, Harumi Nemoto. She has also worked in the softcore movie field, appearing in two V-Cinema works, Bakunyu Sentai Fiber Star Part.1 and its sequel Bakunyu Sentai Fiber Star Part.2, both released in September 2008.  
  
She started her hardcore career as Hitomi in November, 2008 with the video Celebrity Shock AV Debut for the Soft On Demand studio. Her debut videos for SOD were popular enough to elevate her to the [\#6](//sukebei.nyaa.se/?page=view&tid=6) ranking in sales for all actresses from the DMM website for the last half of 2008. She continued to be one of the top ranked actresses at DMM in 2009, ranking [\#27](//sukebei.nyaa.se/?page=view&tid=27) for the first half of the year and [\#42](//sukebei.nyaa.se/?page=view&tid=42) for the full year. She made several more videos for SOD in 2008 and 2009 and in August 2009, the company released Hitomi Premium Collection 8 Hours which included material from all of her previous solo videos.  
  
Japanese adult video stars have proven popular in other parts of Asia as well and Hitomi along with fellow SOD AV star Sasa Handa traveled to Shanghai to represent the SOD company at the March 2009 Shanghai Adult Exhibition. In August 2009, Tanaka began working with a new company, Arashi-Supergirl, part of the large Hokuto Corporation group of companies. By early 2010, she was making videos with two other Hokuto companies, Oppai and Moodyz. In 2011, she began appearing in photoshoots and videos for the American company Scoreland.
